page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.13xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this server features 56 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 28 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The processor operates at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz and includes a 35 MB L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25% tier, reflecting the older architecture and moderate clock speed of the Intel Xeon 8269CY. Single-threaded gzip compression is also low, placing in the bottom 10%. However, the high core count compensates in parallelized workloads. Multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all rank in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests, including both cached small-block and uncached large-block reads, consistently achieve average tier results.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.sn2.13xlarge offers moderate resource density. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that can leverage its 56 vCPUs in parallel rather than relying on high single-thread performance. The instance is suitable for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate software compilation tasks, all of which score in the average tier. It can also handle basic LLM inference for small to medium models, though text generation speeds are limited by the single-core performance constraints.
